[RARC.5.5.2] The clock source is **mockable as a first-class API**
per [LTES.3]; the integrator's mock clock is [NTST.3]'s. In live mode, the clock source reads the
host's monotonic clock and its UTC wall clock, one sample of each per step
([LTIM.2.8.4]). In test / replay mode, it returns whatever the harness or
the recording sets for each. No code path reads wall-clock time
outside the clock source.
